trace.query: Is drinking alcoholic beverages a minor or a major offense?

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_510
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
calling/giving derogatory names etc.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 6. Drinking/Alcohol-related Concerns. Drinking alcoholic beverages or exhibition of any drunken behavior within the University premises.

6.1. Drinking alcoholic beverages
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

6.2. Any drunkenness or drunken behavior resulting in physical injuries to other person/s or destruction of property/ies.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month and payment of damages
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester and payment for damages
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University and payment of damages

Sec. 7. Deception and Forgery. Intentional making of a false statement of any material or fact, or practicing or attempting to practice any deception or fraud in connection with his admission registration in or graduation from the University. (Forging signature and falsifying public documents.)
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1)

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_508
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
within the University premises any firearm/s, knife with a blade longer than 2- 1/2 inches, ice pick, explosive/s or any other dangerous or deadly weapon/s is a major offense. However, this provision shall not apply to anyone who possesses bolo/s and other monitored tools in connection with his/her studies or field of activities. Case of unauthorized possession of firearms shall be reported to Safety and Security Management Office.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) year
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 5. Bullying (RA 10627 or the Anti-Bullying Act of 2013)

5.1. Any severe or repeated use of written or verbal expression, physical act or gesture, or a combination thereof that is directed against another student, causing or placing the latter in reasonable fear of physical or emotional harm or damage to his/her property.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

5.2.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_516
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
for the recognition and operation (based on the ISO coded form approved guidelines for application, recognition and operation of student organizations).
 1st Offense: Warning
 2nd Offense: The student organization is banned to operate for one (1) semester
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

14.3 Recruitment of an unauthorized and unrecognized organization that promotes hazing and physical or psychological harm to students.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one semester
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one year
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 15. Vandalism or Destruction of Public Properties. Destroying property which includes breakage of glass windows; chairs dragging; misuse of tools and equipment; drawing on the walls and pieces of furniture; act of tearing off or defacing any library books, magazines and periodicals; posting illegal/unauthorized notices; picking of fruits, uprooting and cutting of plant; arson and any other form of destructions.
 1st Offense: Suspension for one (1) month and demand payment for damages
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester and demand payment for damages
 3rd Offense: Expulsion from the University

Sec. 16. Other Acts.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_513
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 2. Major Offense. A student shall be subjected to disciplinary action ranging from deprivation of certain students’ privileges, suspension and expulsion if he commits serious deviations from the expected norm of behavior as an LSPU student. The following acts are strictly prohibited.
for one (1) week and 40 hours service to be rendered in the institution
 2nd Offense: Suspension for one (1) month
 3rd Offense: Suspension for one (1) semester

Sec. 10. Narcotics-related Concerns. Possession, use or distribution of any prohibited drugs or chemicals such as LSD, ecstasy, marijuana, Methamphetamine (shabu), heroin, or opiates of any form (R.A. 9165) will be reported to Safety and Security Office. Parents will also be informed.
 Sanction (all offenses): 1st offense: Suspension for one (1) semester or dismissal according to the gravity of the offense. Before re-admission (after the suspension). No. 64, s.

SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 3. Minor Offense

1.2.4. Every student shall secure an excuse slip from the Guidance Office for absence/s made before admission to classes.

Sec. 2. Dishonesty. Any form of cheating in examinations.
 1st Offense: Automatically failed in examination
 2nd Offense: Academic probation and automatic grade of 5.0.
 3rd Offense: Subsequent offense: Dismissal from the University

2.1 Any act of dishonesty in relation to his studies and any other forms of dishonesty.
 1st Offense: Reprimand with community service
 2nd Offense: Promissory note duly signed by the Guidance Counselor/Student Discipline Coordinator and two (2) days community service
 3rd Offense: Subsequent offense: Suspension for two (2) weeks

Sect. 3. Littering/Scattering of Trash in Public Places. Proper disposal of waste, trash, garbage and the like shall always be observed. Comfort rooms, trash cans, containers, garbage pit-piles are provided for this purpose. Anyone who violates this provision shall be required to clean any portion of the University without pay for a specific period.
 1st Offense: Required to clean the area
